name: Max-Q: thrust sweep
description: More thrust gets the rocket moving faster while the air is still thick, so the dynamic pressure, the push of the oncoming air, peaks higher: from about 65 kPa at 1300 kN to nearly 120 kPa at 2100 kN. Watch the Dynamic pressure graph. That peak, max-Q, is the hardest moment for the rocket's structure, which is why real rockets throttle back through it.
